description: MySQL / MariaDB config audit — Offline security audit of a MySQL or MariaDB option file (my.cnf, mysqld.cnf, server.cnf): skip-grant-tables, bind-address exposure, require_secure_transport, TLS 1.0/1.1 and weak ciphers, local_infile (server and client), empty secure_file_priv, allow-suspicious-udfs, log_raw, running as root, old/native password hashing, symbolic-links, general_log, validate_password policy, X Protocol bind, skip_name_resolve, sql_mode, max_connect_errors, plaintext passwords in [client] sections (never echoed), duplicate keys (last wins). Returns PASS / REVIEW / FIX BEFORE DEPLOY / BLOCK, score, grade, findings with line numbers and fixes, effective server settings and a hardened example. Params: text= (config contents) or url= (raw or GitHub blob URL). Example: /v1/security/mysql-check?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/org/repo/main/my.cnf Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_mysql_check
